sessionName: Week 6 - One system for deal partners
summary: George Berrington reviewed revenue operations with Thomas Avery and Grace Lindqvist. Deal partner contacts are split across Outlook, a shared spreadsheet and the timesheet system, and nobody can see relationship history. We agreed to adopt a relationship-focused CRM, define the core funnel metrics and give the partners a fortnightly pipeline view.

discussion.keyPoints: Thomas confirmed contacts live in personal Outlook folders and a spreadsheet. Grace said when a director leaves, relationships go with them.
George suggested a relationship-intelligence CRM built for advisory firms rather than a generic sales CRM. Thomas was concerned about cost at around 900 pounds per user per year.
Grace wanted the five-stage pipeline from week 5 and win rate by sector visible in one place.

recommendations.recommendation: Adopt a relationship-intelligence CRM for all 8 directors and partners, live by the end of next quarter.
Each deal partner record must show fund, sector focus and last meeting date, reviewed monthly by Grace.
Track four metrics: pre-RFP conversations, scoping call rate, win rate by sector and average fee.
Review a fortnightly pipeline dashboard in the Monday partners meeting.
Forecast revenue weekly by mandate probability.

actions.action: Get quotes from two relationship-intelligence CRM vendors
Approve CRM budget once quotes are in

nextFocus: Plan marketing campaigns around sector insight and the deal library.
nextPreparation: Grace to gather any sector content Brookvale has published in the last year.

tests.question: What four funnel metrics are we tracking?
When do we review the pipeline dashboard?
